newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving up slightly.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may gain slightly on Sunday as small investors are expected to return amid institutional support, brokers said.

"The market has stabilised after a lingering bearish spell. Many of the scrips have reached to their lowest level and there is no further scope for the market to go downwards at the moment," said broker Khurshid Alam.
The DSE benchmark index rose 1.08 points or 0.12 percent at 1,139.54 on a turnover of 48.2 million taka on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
